headline: 47 contracts catalogued on TRON Mainnet across V1 SBM (22 jToken markets), governance, oracle, interest-rate, and V2 (Moolah/sTRX/EnergyRental) subsystems; Timelock + GovernorBravo governance chain identified; TRON Base58 addresses are schema-incompatible with EVM 0x format and DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support TRON.
short_headline: 47 contracts on TRON; governance chain identified

findings.text: D1: TRON block explorer (tronscan.org) referenced in CertiK audit alleviation notes listing 24+ contract addresses with labels (CEther/Unitroller/CErc20Delegator, Timelock, GovernorAlpha, WJST). Direct Tronscan fetch not attempted (TRON is not an EVM chain supported by block-explorer allowlist). Canonical address list cross-referenced from docs.justlend.org deployed contracts page.

D2: Official deployed contracts doc found at https://docs.justlend.org/developers/deployed_contracts/ — fetched successfully. Lists: Unitroller (proxy), Comptroller (impl), 22 jToken delegator+delegate pairs (V1 SBM), interest rate models (2 WhitePaper + 21 JumpRateV2), PriceOracleProxy + PriceOracle impl, GovernorBravoDelegator + impl, Timelock, V2 Moolah market + vault factory, sTRX, EnergyRental, resilient oracle suite, liquidator contracts. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: CertiK audit PDF (justlend.org/docs/justlend_audit_en.pdf) fetched. Audit scope covers 28 source files at commit bed296fc6205658cc5b5ca871f9ac9dd69e303d9. Alleviation for GLOBAL-01 lists 24 Tronscan contract URLs (CEther/Unitroller/CErc20Delegator instances + market contracts). Alleviation for GLOBAL-01 identifies Timelock at TRWNvb15NmfNKNLhQpxefFz7cNjrYjEw7x and governance at TH1SVVVU9NF1ans3CRBCJ5kW2yvn4sHP9b (audit-era GovernorAlpha, since superseded by GovernorBravo per docs). Alleviation for WJS-01 identifies WJST at TCczUFrX1u4v1mzjBVXsiVyehj1vCaNxDt. CTJ-02 alleviation identifies 7 jToken market delegator addresses.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/justlend/justlend-protocol confirmed via web_search (found in search results with codebase description matching audit scope). Direct fetch blocked by allowlist (URL not previously surfaced by a tool call). Commit SHA bed296fc6205658cc5b5ca871f9ac9dd69e303d9 pinned from audit PDF. Additional repo https://github.com/justlend/mcp-server-justlend surfaced via search, contains chains.ts with canonical contract addresses — not fetched due to allowlist.

D5: Single chain (TRON). No multi-chain enumeration needed. All contracts are on TRON Mainnet. DeFiPunkd on-chain API does not support TRON (chainId not in supported list: 1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111). No on-chain reads possible for this protocol this run.

D6: No factory-discovered children required. jToken market list is fully enumerated in the official docs (22 markets in V1 SBM, 6 legacy closed markets included). V2 Moolah Vault Factory (TYoUEF2jB5WdTSVKRTmbUtC9iieVUPY1XK) noted; vault children enumerated in docs (USDT, USDD, TRX vaults). Cap notice: Vault Factory child enumeration is complete per docs (3 vaults listed).

D7: Role taxonomy applied. Governance chain: GovernorBravoDelegator (governor) → Timelock (timelock, 48h min delay) → admin of Unitroller/CErc20Delegator/WJST. WJST (token) is governance voting wrapper for JST deposits. PriceOracleProxy (oracle). 22 jToken CErc20Delegator contracts (pool). Unitroller (proxy_admin/comptroller proxy). All roles classified per controlled vocabulary.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] traced to fetched URLs: docs page (https://docs.justlend.org/developers/deployed_contracts/, fetched this run) and CertiK audit PDF (https://justlend.org/docs/justlend_audit_en.pdf, fetched this run). TRON Base58 address format is incompatible with schema address field (^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$). Admin addresses recorded with role/chain in unknowns per D8 code since they cannot be stored in admin_addresses[] with valid 0x format.

rationale.verdict: Discovery completed via audit PDF and official docs fetch. 47+ contracts catalogued on TRON Mainnet. On-chain verification is impossible because DeFiPunkd API does not support TRON, and TRON Base58 addresses are schema-incompatible with the required 0x EVM format; grade is unknown pending format/chain support resolution.

Audit scope: 28 Solidity source files at commit bed296fc6205658cc5b5ca871f9ac9dd69e303d9 of github.com/justlend/justlend-protocol. GLOBAL-01 alleviation lists 24 deployed contract Tronscan URLs including jToken markets, Timelock (TRWNvb15NmfNKNLhQpxefFz7cNjrYjEw7x), and governance (TH1SVVVU9NF1ans3CRBCJ5kW2yvn4sHP9b). WJS-01 identifies WJST at TCczUFrX1u4v1mzjBVXsiVyehj1vCaNxDt. Governance architecture: CEther/Unitroller/CErc20Delegator admin transferred to Timelock (48h delay); Timelock admin is governance contract.

Official JustLend DAO deployed contracts page (fetched 2026-07-07). Lists all V1 SBM jToken markets (22 total, 6 legacy), V1 core (Unitroller TGjYzgCyPobsNS9n6WcbdLVR9dH7mWqFx7, Comptroller impl TB23wYojvAsSx6gR8ebHiBqwSeABiBMPAr), interest rate models (23), PriceOracle proxy TGnYnSn4G9PgWFj7QQemh4YMZKp3fkympJ + impl TMiNCmvD3zdsv6mk7niBU6NPBzVNjYMQTV, GovernorBravoDelegator TEqiF5JbhDPD77yjEfnEMncGRZNDt2uogD + impl, Timelock TRWNvb15NmfNKNLhQpxefFz7cNjrYjEw7x, V2 Moolah market/vault/oracle/liquidator contracts, sTRX TU3kjFuhtEo42tsCBtfYUAZxoqQ4yuSLQ5, EnergyRental TU2MJ5Veik1LRAgjeSzEdvmDYx7mefJZvd.
JustLend DAO website confirmed live. SPA requiring JavaScript. Protocol described as first official lending platform on TRON.

protocol_metadata.about: JustLend DAO is the largest lending protocol on TRON, built on the Compound V2 architecture, where users supply TRX or TRC20 assets to earn interest or borrow against over-collateralized positions via jToken (CErc20Delegator proxy) markets. The protocol uses an upgradeable proxy pattern (Unitroller/Comptroller for risk parameters, CErc20Delegator per market) with a GovernorBravo + Timelock governance chain (48-hour minimum delay) controlled by WJST-weighted voting. Additional sub-protocols include sTRX liquid staking, Energy Rental, and a V2 isolated-collateral Moolah market with vault-based liquidity aggregation.
